note: Hero layers for straightscale.com act 1. Fractions are of the 16:9 desktop frame (WEB-HERO-D@v2, 2688x1520) unless marked portrait. Built in the Higgsfield sandbox by tools/hero_build.py (copy in the run folder notes); files hosted on the Higgsfield CDN (https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_3CQo67nOEoDBnYQeXyEukxi74Z6/<media_id>.webp).

poster_desktop.what: plate + far + cup composited at rest

plate.what: master with the window glass keyed to alpha (x 0.614 to 0.981, y 0 to 0.563, 1 px feather)

far.what: the master's own window view, sky extended 16% above, 2% at the sides, 3% below

cup.what: porcelain matte (coffee filled, handle loop kept open), exposure 0.9, Gaussian defocus 9 px at master scale

poster_portrait.what: 9:16 crop of the desktop composite, x 0.436 to 0.7541 (interim until WEB-HERO-M is generated; its spec passed G-SPEC on 21 Oct)

screen.measured_by: fresh visual reviewer, line fits to the glass edges on the 2688x1520 source (+-2 px)

notification.how: affine map of the card's axes onto the screen's long edge (TL to TR) and short edge (TL to BL); origin 10% along the long edge and 16% along the short edge; width 80% of the long edge
